risks: No participants. The ethical risk is a committee decision that spreads pharmacists too thin or relies on written advice in settings where it is ignored.
consent: Not applicable; no human participants or personal data.
data: Published and publicly available reports only; the network's own audit data are context and are not analysed.
equity: PROGRESS-Plus and setting: the map records hospital size, language of the report and whether studies reported outcomes by age, sex or rurality, so the committee can see whether the evidence reaches patients in the small, largely French-speaking hospital.
effectiveness: Succeeds if the committee receives both strands, clearly separated, with their limits, by 31 March 2027.
efficiency: Staff time within approved allocations; library support within existing services.
partnerships: The network library, the pharmacy resident, the infectious diseases fellow, a surgical nurse manager and a patient partner from the network's patient advisory council for the committee summary.
rebPath: No REB review needed: no human participants or identifiable data.
limitations: English and French only; single screening before January; strand B studies mostly from large teaching hospitals.
summary: No participants; equity charted by hospital size and language.
